rows.name: GitHubGetRepo

rows.description: List branches in a repository.
rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubListCommits
rows.description: List commits on a repository, optionally filtered by branch/sha or path.

sha.description: Branch name or commit SHA to start from.

path.description: Only commits touching this file path.

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubGetCommit
rows.description: Get a single commit, including its diff stats and changed files.
rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubGetFileContents
rows.description: Get a file or directory listing. File content is returned base64-encoded in the `content` field.

path.description: Path to the file or directory in the repo.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA (defaults to the default branch).

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of decoded text to return (default 40000).

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubCreateOrUpdateFile
rows.description: Create or update a file. Provide plain-text `content` (encoded to base64 automatically). Pass `sha` when updating an existing file.

path.description: Path to the file in the repo.

branch.description: Target branch (defaults to the default branch).

sha.description: Blob SHA of the file being replaced (required when updating).

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubGetRef
rows.description: Get a Git reference (branch or tag head). Returns the current SHA for ref names like `heads/main`.

ref.description: Ref name relative to `refs/`, e.g. `heads/main` or `tags/v1`.

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubCreateTree
rows.description: Create a Git tree from file entries. Pair with GitHubCreateCommit and GitHubUpdateRef to push commits via the API without a local clone.

baseTree.description: SHA of an existing tree to apply the entries on top of.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

content.description: Plain UTF-8 file content (creates a new blob).

sha.description: SHA of an existing blob/tree to point the entry at.

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubCreateCommit
rows.description: Create a commit object for a tree SHA with parent commit SHAs.

tree.description: Git tree SHA the commit points to.

parents.description: Parent commit SHAs (one for a normal commit).

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubUpdateRef
rows.description: Point a Git reference at a new commit SHA — the final step of pushing commits via the API.

sha.description: Commit SHA the ref should point to.

force.description: Overwrite the ref even when not a fast-forward.

rows.subject: example/project

rows.name: GitHubCreateBranch
rows.description: Create a new branch pointing at an existing commit SHA.

sha.description: Commit SHA the new branch points to.
